meta.name: documentation-lookup
meta.description: Use up-to-date library and framework docs via Context7 MCP instead of training data. Activates for setup questions, API references, code examples, or when the user names a framework (e.g. React, Next.js, Prisma).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查框架和库的最新文档与代码示例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发时经常需要查框架或库的最新文档
copy.tagline_en: Look up latest docs and code examples for frameworks and libraries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need up-to-date documentation for frameworks and libraries

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从 Context7 获取最新的库和框架文档，而不是依赖训练数据。它会先解析库名称，再查询文档，最后用真实信息回答你的问题。
howto.when: 当你询问库或框架的安装、配置、API 或代码示例时触发。例如提到 React、Next.js、Prisma 等具体名称。

say.note: Claude 会查询 Next.js 最新文档并给出步骤。

say.text: 用 Prisma 查询关联数据怎么写？
say.note: Claude 会从 Prisma 文档获取示例代码。
Claude 会查找 Supabase 文档并列出方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches the latest library and framework docs via Context7 instead of relying on training data. It resolves the library name, queries the docs, and answers with up-to-date information.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about setup, configuration, API references, or code examples for libraries/frameworks, or when you mention names like React, Next.js, Prisma, etc.

say_en.text: How do I configure Next.js middleware?
say_en.note: Claude queries Next.js docs and provides steps.

say_en.text: Write a Prisma query with relations.
say_en.note: Claude fetches Prisma docs for example code.

say_en.text: What are the Supabase auth methods?
say_en.note: Claude looks up Supabase docs and lists methods.
